verdict: ROAS is holding over 28 days, but purchase momentum is slipping.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Meta ads returned $7,320.31 in revenue on $1,363.04 in spend — a solid 5.37x return for the full period. However, the more recent picture is softer: purchases dropped 35.71% and ROAS fell 24.33% compared to the prior week, with just 3 purchases recorded across the last 3 days of the window. The data points to creative fatigue on your top-spending campaign, not a budget or audience problem — spend has stayed flat while results have declined, which is a clear signal the ads need fresh creative. New ad creative is being introduced this week to reverse the close-rate decline, and you should expect purchase volume to stabilize as the refreshed ads ramp up.
